Grit charitra banata hai.
Sahan-shakti grit ki kunji hai.
Grit faulad hai.
Silence words se zyada strong hota hai.
Grit grind ko respect karti hai.
Hard dinon pe aa jana—grit.
Grit sapno ko hakikat bana deta hai.
Courage woh ladder hai—jisme saare aur virtues chadhte.
Khamoshi woh space hai jahan healing hoti.
Sabse bada sahas wahi hai jab duniya tumhe koi aur banne ko kehti hai, tum khud ki tarah rehna.
Grit ka matlab hai zindagi ko sprint nahi balki marathon ki tarah jeena.
Nadiyan yeh jaanti hain ki koi jaldi nahi hai, hum ek din wahan pahunch hi jayenge.
Apurn hone ki himmat rakho.
Grit dil ki lagan aur jidd hai.
Himmat dar ka ilaaj hai.
Chuppi mein bramhand hai.
Courage ka matlab darr ka na hona nahi, balki us par jeet haasil karna hai.
Grit setbacks ko setups banata.
